contributionFlow: One PR adds up to three entry YAML files.
CI checks submission shape, dsh.bundle manifest and source requirements.
A maintainer reads the plugin source and checks functionality claims.
Merge regenerates bilingual READMEs, triggers static website build and deployment.
Scheduled probes refresh npm mapping, stars, releases, and other metadata; decay scanning supports removal review.

features: One discussion per plugin shared across surfaces

deepseekOfficial.generatorBehavior: Reads npm manifests and Git objects, retains per-source last successful results, pins immutable versions/commits, validates index, and does not run package code.
limits: A valid format does not prove package metadata matches code.
The caller must enforce document size limits.
OpenBot persona, memory, permission and model binding semantics need their own schema.

adopt: Single entry file per item with strict schema validation
One canonical catalog generates documentation, website and app index
Source URL, author, license, version/commit and verification date on every item
Contributor PR plus automated checks plus functional review
Maintenance probes and clear stale/unavailable states
adapt: Catalog app interaction patterns to OpenBot native UI
Separate Bot templates, skill packs, DSH plugins and runtime integrations with explicit item kinds
Use existing OpenBot market install/upgrade/rollback core for Bot templates
Read the DSH standard only for DSH-compatible plugin entries; keep a thin adapter
doNotCopy: Treating thousands of DSH plugins as thousands of Bot identities
Assuming catalog CC0 grants rights to all package code
Installing every entry solely because it is high-star or listed
Exporting live profile credentials as public Bot templates
